title: Managed (lifecycle) nodes
keywords: lifecycle managed node state unconfigured inactive active configure activate deactivate lifecycle_manager
text: Lifecycle (managed) nodes move through the states unconfigured, inactive, active and finalized, using the transitions configure, activate, deactivate, cleanup and shutdown. A lifecycle publisher sends nothing until the node is active, so its topic exists but stays silent. ros2 lifecycle get /node shows the state and ros2 lifecycle set /node activate changes it. Navigation stacks and many drivers bring nodes up through a lifecycle manager; if one node fails to activate, the nodes that depend on it wait.
